test_name: Verify Navigation to 'Analysis' Page and Search Functionality
description: This test verifies that the user can navigate to the 'Analysis' page from the dashboard and use the search box to filter analysis results.
steps: Navigate to the primary dashboard at https://dev.roost.ai.
Click on the 'RoostGPT' tab using the selector [data-testid="roostGPT-tab"].
Once the 'RoostGPT' page loads, click on the 'Analysis' link using the selector //a[@href='/roostgpt/analyses' and contains(@class, 'headerButton_collabButton__1E3Qx')].
Verify that the 'Analysis' page URL is https://dev.roost.ai/roostgpt/analyses.
Locate the search input box using the selector [data-testid="events-search-box"].
Type the search term 'performance' into the search input box.
Press the Enter key to initiate the search.
Validate that the displayed results on the 'Analysis' page are filtered based on the search term 'performance'.
expected_results: The user successfully navigates to the 'Analysis' page.
The search input box is functional and responsive.
The search results are accurately filtered based on the entered query.
edge_cases: Search with no input and verify no results or an empty state message.
Search with special characters and ensure the system handles it gracefully.
Search with an extremely long string to check for input length limits.
Search with a term that yields no results and confirm the proper message is displayed.
Search while the page is still loading and ensure no errors occur.
data_requirements: At least one analysis result containing the term 'performance'.
A functioning search feature in the 'Analysis' page.
A user with the necessary permissions to access the 'Analysis' page.
Browser and network configurations to access the site.
dependencies: The search feature on the 'Analysis' page must be implemented.
api_interactions: API call to fetch analysis data while navigating to the 'Analysis' page.
API call to filter analysis results based on the search query.
performance_metrics: Measure page load time for the 'Analysis' page.
Evaluate search response time after entering a query.
Assess the rendering speed of filtered results.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the search box is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Verify that the 'Analysis' page is screen-reader friendly.
Confirm proper ARIA labels are applied to all interactive elements.
